items.title: 'The party had to end': Young investors torn on budget tax reform
items.description: Some young Australians locked out of the property market due to unaffordable housing have pursued ETFs and "rentvesting" as a way to build financial security. Here's what they make of the budget's CGT reforms.

items.title: Should a nurse pay the same tax rate as their employer? The budget says no
items.description: As the federal budget prompts howls of protest from those who earn the bulk of their income from owning assets rather than working, we shouldn't forget the relative privilege that allowed many of those people to take those risks.

items.title: Man charged with murder after woman and two children found dead in Sydney home
items.description: A man, 47, has been charged after three people were found dead in a home in Sydney's south-west in what police allege is a domestic violence-related incident.

items.title: Trump says he has postponed a planned new strike on Iran
items.description: US President Donald Trump says an attack on Iran that was "scheduled for tomorrow" has been postponed at the request of gulf state leaders.

items.title: Breaking: Two suspects dead in shooting at San Diego mosque, police sources say
items.description: A shooter has opened fire at a San Diego mosque and police believe people have been shot, authorities say.

items.title: 'I wish I were dead': The heartbreaking toll of Australia's favourite pastime
items.description: Australians are the world's biggest gamblers, losing billions every year. But the true cost goes far beyond the financial.

items.title: Elon Musk loses lawsuit against OpenAI and Sam Altman
items.description: The Tesla boss accused OpenAI of wrongfully trying to enrich investors and insiders at the nonprofit's expense, and failing to prioritise AI's safety.

items.title: Israeli forces intercept Gaza flotilla with Australians on board, organisers say
items.description: The organisers of a flotilla of ships trying to break Israel's maritime blockade of Gaza say Israel's navy is intercepting the group off the coast of Cyprus.

items.title: The parts of Victoria adding the biggest share to disaster damage bills
items.description: At least $57 billion worth of infrastructure in Victoria is vulnerable to more frequent and severe bushfires, floods and extreme heat. This figure is expected to grow.

items.title: 'Two years to live': Why we used our super for weight loss surgery
items.description: Weight loss surgery has become an increasingly common option for people grappling with obesity — and many are funding it using retirement savings.

items.title: Bodies of four missing Italian scuba divers found in underwater cave in Maldives
items.description: The bodies of four missing Italian scuba divers who died last week have been found in an underwater cave in the Maldives.

items.title: 'It took some bravery': Kylie Minogue on lost loves, Netflix doco and AFL
items.description: Australia's reigning Queen of Pop discusses her relationships with Nick Cave and the late Michael Hutchence, and being tapped to headline the AFL grand final's pre-game entertainment.

items.title: Overseas company makes billions in profit but is receiving millions in government bailouts
items.description: China is "playing a hard game" with its stranglehold on the global minerals and metals market and Australian smelters need taxpayer support to "play hard back".

items.title: Two men arrested over stunt at Punch the monkey's enclosure
items.description: One of the men was detained by a zookeeper and arrested after allegedly climbing a fence and breaking into the enclosure.

items.title: When the law failed them, these men confronted the thief who stole their movie
items.description: What do you do when your stolen film wins a slew of awards for the thief? In the case of these filmmakers, you travel across the globe to hunt him down.

items.title: Today's quiz tests you on iconic movie quotes. You. Shall. (Probably.) Pass!
items.description: The ABC Timelines quiz is back to test your knowledge of some of the most iconic movie quotes of the 2000s.

items.title: Money stress causing tension in your relationship? This might help
items.description: While financial tension between partners isn't always about money, many people clash over values, spending habits, and how they respond to financial pressure.

items.title: A secret mouse experiment in the 1990s threatened Brisbane's water supply
items.description: Brisbane was days away from running out of drinkable water in the 1990s due to a secret mouse experiment that was kept hidden from the public … until now.

items.title: Granny flat ban lifted for some residents under airport flight path
items.description: The NSW government will permit secondary dwellings such as granny flats in some areas affected by noise from Western Sydney International Airport.

items.title: Woman dies after being hit by ute on Pacific Motorway
items.description: Police say initial enquiries indicate a female was out of her vehicle when she was struck.

items.title: It's time for Eric Abetz to tackle Tasmania's debt. How far will he go?
items.description: The lead-up to state budget day is normally a time for flashy funding announcements. But as Tasmania stares down the barrel of $7 billion of debt, things are looking a bit bleaker.

items.title: Behind the front lines of the war against illegal waste
items.description: While Queensland councils cleaned up enough illegally dumped waste to fill more than 1,200 garbage trucks, investigators say they are getting better at catching those doing the wrong thing.

items.title: How a dead salmon disaster swamped Tasmania's waste system
items.description: High-volume salmon mortalities last year swamped Tasmania's waste streams as companies scrambled to find somewhere to accept them, documents show. There are now concerns the state remains unprepared for future mass deaths.

items.title: Spanish PM's Socialists party on notice after historic defeat in stronghold
items.description: Voters in the region of Andalusia have sent the ruling Spain's Socialists yet another warning, adding to concerns Pedro Sánchez's government could suffer an electoral wipe-out in a nationwide vote.

items.title: Journalist in London stabbed at behest of Iran, court told
items.description: Pouria Zaratifoukolaei, who works for a Persian-language outlet critical of the Iranian government, was attacked near his home in London in 2024.
